text:
devin-sales: Hey CS team — passing off SignalHealth (pilot signed today). Quick context: they'll run a 2-week POC, need private VPC eval + SSO (SAML), want a dedicated burst capacity for demo traffic, and billing net-30. Can CS own the customer kickoff and coordinate with eng/support for SSO and private infra? Also capturing renewal risk: pilot could convert to annual if performance meets SLA.

maria-cs: Congrats! I can own this. Assigning owners now. Can @aj-support take the infra provisioning and staging VPC? @nora-eng for SSO integration and any eng blockers. I'll schedule the kickoff for Mon AM and create the onboarding ticket.

aj-support: I can take infra. Need: VPC CIDR, cloud account (they're on AWS us-west-2), expected peak QPS, and any allowed IP ranges. I'll spin up staging VPC and open a support runbook.

nora-eng: I'll own SAML work and the quick validation for private deploy. Heads-up: if they require HSM/KMS integration that adds ~2w; for the POC we can use managed KMS. Also need IdP metadata and a test user.

devin-sales: Details from the customer: AWS us-west-2, CIDR 10.10.0.0/16, expected burst ~200 rps (sustained ~20 rps), average token length ~120. Contact: lia@signalhealth.com. POC start target is next Tuesday.

maria-cs: Creating onboarding ticket and owners now: CS = maria-cs, Support = aj-support, Eng = nora-eng. I'll link the deploy runbook and SSO checklist in the ticket.

maria-cs: Tickets created: JIRA INF-2345 (private deploy), JIRA SSO-678 (SAML work), ONB-910 (customer onboarding). Target 30-day milestones: provisioning (3d), SSO demo (5d), integration call (by day 3).

aj-support: Noted. I'll request infra from infra-ops and tag them in the runbook. Will include a rollback/runbook snippet in the ticket.

nora-eng: For SAML I need their IdP metadata xml and ACS URL. Devin — please ask them to share metadata + a test account with admin rights.

devin-sales: Sent metadata to nora@redwood.com and uploaded to the onboarding doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/onboarding/signalhealth. Also shared accounting contact: accounting@signalhealth.com and PO# 7782.

maria-cs: I'll run a quick pre-kick checklist: product access, API keys, SDK examples, sample prompts, and an eval set. Also logging a renewal risk note: pilot is at a 60% discount; if median latency >120ms or token cost >$0.003 per token we need to propose an optimized config or quantized variant.

aj-support: Small infra note — for dedicated burst we recommend NVIDIA A10G or similar; we'll need expected token lengths and max concurrent connections to size pools. Also adding traffic shaping plan if burst >90% of GPU capacity.

devin-sales: Confirmed token length ~120, A10G is fine. They've asked for a safety net: auto-fallback to hosted lower-cost variant if capacity constrained.

maria-cs: Action items recap (first 30d): 1) Staging VPC + creds (aj-support, 72h) 2) SAML integration + test (nora-eng, 5d) 3) Onboarding call + integration checklist (maria-cs, 72h) 4) Billing terms confirmation (devin-sales, 48h) 5) Eval set + latency baseline (maria-cs + aj-support, 7d). I'll update ONB-910 with owners and deadlines.

nora-eng: If SAML or private deploy hits an eng blocker I'll open an urgent PR and coordinate a canary deploy.

maria-cs: I'll send a one-page kickoff email to SignalHealth with owners and next steps. Anything to add?

aj-support: Add a rollback plan for the POC and a clear escalation path to eng if latency/regression shows up during demo.

devin-sales: Also confirm net-30 invoice and PO# 7782 with accounting; customer expects invoice within 30 days of signing.

maria-cs: Thanks all — kickoff scheduled Mon 10am PST. Owners confirmed and tasks started. :rocket:

onboard-bot: Reminder created: ONB-910 assigned to maria-cs (due in 72 hours).

maria-cs: Closing the loop — will post updates in the ticket and ping this thread for any blockers. :thumbsup:
